text: {"label":"Behavioral Economics Applications and Policy","definition":"Broad overviews and applications of behavioral economics to research, practice, public policy, health, sustainability, poverty, consumer behavior, and the economics of the behavior-analytic profession, such as fees and pay equity.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Covers behavioral economics broadly and its policy and societal uses, not demand curves and purchase tasks specifically, quantitative choice models, or basic reinforcement processes."}
